heroSection.description: BucksPay is the white-label infrastructure for your business to get paid in stablecoins across Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum and Stellar. Non-custodial — funds settle straight to your wallet.
heroSection.trust: Works with the chains and wallets you already use

servicesSection.title-1: Pay with crypto - no more manual currency conversions to worry about.

showcaseSection.title: Your payment infrastructure, on autopilot
showcaseSection.subtitle: Accept stablecoins across multiple chains, with automatic on-chain confirmation and settlement straight to your wallet. You bring the brand; we bring the tech.

aboutSection.title: The professional way to get paid in crypto
aboutSection.description: Infrastructure ready for your business to accept stablecoin payments, under your brand and without the technical hassle.

whiteLabel.title: Get paid under your brand
whiteLabel.description: Custom payment pages with your logo, colors and domain. Your customers pay in an experience that's entirely yours.

nonCustodial.title: Non-custodial by design
nonCustodial.description: Funds settle straight to your wallet. BucksPay never touches your money — you stay in full control.

multichain.title: Multi-chain, zero friction
multichain.description: Accept stablecoins on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum and Stellar, with MetaMask, WalletConnect and Coinbase.

benefitsSection.description: Accepting stablecoins with BucksPay isn't just new tech: it's instant settlement, lower fees and global reach — without adding complexity to your operation.

instantSettlement.title: Instant settlement
instantSettlement.description: Every payment confirms on-chain and lands straight in your wallet in minutes. No bank settlement delays, no holds.

lowerFees.title: Lower fees
lowerFees.description: No middlemen, no chargebacks. You keep more of every sale and forget about disputes.

globalReach.title: Global reach
globalReach.description: Anyone with a wallet can pay you — no borders, no bank accounts. Sell worldwide from day one.

howWorksSection.title: Get paid in four steps
howWorksSection.description: From creating the link to funds landing in your wallet — without writing a single line of code.

createLink.title: Create your payment link
createLink.description: From the dashboard, generate a link with a fixed, open or ranged amount. Reusable or single-use.

share.title: Share it with your customer
share.description: Send the branded URL anywhere: web, WhatsApp, email or a QR code.

customerPays.title: Your customer pays with their wallet
customerPays.description: They connect MetaMask, WalletConnect or Coinbase, sign the transaction and that's it.

settle.title: Funds land instantly
settle.description: The transaction confirms on-chain and the money settles straight to your wallet. Track it in your analytics.

testimonialsSection.title: Businesses already getting paid with BucksPay
testimonialsSection.description: E-commerce, SaaS and service teams that added crypto payments under their own brand — non-custodial and across multiple chains.
